card.title: How to use ODIN to flash firmware on Samsung devices

source.title: How to use ODIN to flash firmware on Samsung devices

models: Samsung Galaxy (most S, Note, A, Z and Tab models)

claims.statement: Odin flashes Samsung stock firmware (BL, AP, CP, CSC) in Download Mode and can recover bootloops or logo hangs.
Use HOME_CSC to keep user data; the plain CSC file wipes the device.
Read model, firmware version and CSC in Download Mode (e.g. SamKey 'Read Info D/L') and download the matching firmware (e.g. samfw.com).
If the device can't enter Download Mode, Odin can't help—suspect CPU or eMMC hardware failure.

procedure: Enter Download Mode and connect USB.
Load BL, AP, CP and HOME_CSC (or CSC to wipe) into Odin.
cautions: SOURCE RISK: Loading the plain CSC file erases user data.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
